rows.definition: The configuration struct `WavePlanOptions` (internal/debtlane/wave.go and internal/issueorchestrator/wave.go) passed to each `PlanWaves` - wave size cap, max waves, target grade/points, excluded lanes, held-lane auto-detect, and graph override - that shapes how a wave plan is generated.
rows.distinction: The INPUT config that shapes wave generation - NOT the produced `WavePlan` campaign plan itself (its output) and NOT the umbrella `plan` domain.
